summary: Founder Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting amendments to two pre-existing financing agreements with Streeterville Capital and Avondale Capital. The Note Amendment and Pre-Paid Purchase Amendment revise conversion/purchase prices to the lower of 85% of the 10-day lowest daily VWAP or 85% of the lowest intraday hourly VWAP. No new securities, corporate action, or strategic event is announced. This is a routine debt document modification under an ongoing financing arrangement, not a special situation.
